name: n-D Iso-surface Extraction via Recursive Hypercube Projection
definition: A recursive algorithm to extract oriented hyper-iso-surfaces in n-dimensional space by projecting an nD hypercube onto 2D planes, localizing iso-vertices, and re-assembling results while maintaining orientation coherence.
summary: This method extracts oriented iso-surfaces in arbitrary dimensions by recursively projecting hypercubes onto 2D planes, avoiding exhaustive combinatorial tables to ensure topological correctness.
